notes.title: Update #2
notes.content:
WARNING: YOU HAVE TO RESTART LEVEL AFTER THIS UPDATE. START THE GAME AND THEN CHOOSE "RESTART LEVEL" FROM MENU.

- Changed save system
- Added "Restart level" option
- Added mouse invert option
- Large FPS improvement in the battles
- Fixed enemies
- Fixed couple small bugs
